eps.t: Phineas and Ferb/Hamster & Gretel/Milo Murphy's Law: Life with Linda
eps.o: MOM. Phineas and Ferb are in another triple crossover with Hamster and Gretel and Milo Murphy's Law. In this short, Linda manages to avoid seeing all the hijinks the main characters in the Dwampyverse get up to.

eps.t: Phineas and Ferb: Space Mountain Mayhem
eps.o: Phineas and Ferb have their sights set on space. But no silly star will do, they're out to conquer the sizable Space Mountain.
When Dr. Doof invents a balloon-inator, will Perry the Platypus be able to pop his evil plans?

eps.t: Phineas and Ferb/Hamster & Gretel: Super Pet Pals
eps.o: The powerful pets Perry the Platypus and Hamster team up to stop a group of sneaky supervillains.
When a papier-mâché volcano turns into a full on natural disaster, Hailey teams up with Scott and Beta to save the school.

eps.t: Camp Rock: As Told by Chibi
eps.o: A girl has to work in the kitchen to go to camp? This story is giving major Cinderella vibes in this Chibi retelling of the classic Disney tale.
Kiff and Barry are in the house. Just one problem: it's not theirs.

eps.t: The Owl House/Amphibia: Back to the Swamp
eps.o: It's time to jump for joy and hoot to the heavens because the 'The Owl House' and 'Amphibia' crews are together again for another epic crossover.
When Dr. Doofenshmirtz creates a ray that turns everything into cake, will Perry the Platypus be able to give the evil scientist his just desserts?

eps.t: Hailey's On It: Chaos Bot Picnic
eps.o: When Hailey, Beta and Scott go on a picnic in the park, their perfect summer day is about to be thrown a wrench with the arrival of chaos bots.
When Kiff and Barry come across a tandem bicycle, they're soon inspired to see just how many ridiculous things they can do side by side.
In this medley, Dara Renee sings a comically condensed recap of the entire Disney Descendants trilogy to the tune of Rotten to the Core, Chillin' Like a Villain, and Night Falls.
Best friends Kiff and Barry battle to see who can build the tallest frozen yogurt cone. Whose toppings will come out on top?

eps.t: Primos: Get Baby Bud's Binky Back
eps.o: When a pesky bird snatches Baby Bud's binky, Tater and all her primos jump into action to get it back.
When Tater gets an exciting new book, she's hoping to find some peace and quiet to read it. But when you have 12 cousins, it won't be easy.
Tater discovers that a dozen cousins is a party, but 13 kids are a crowd.

eps.t: Kiff/ZOMBIES/The Owl House: Witches Night Out
eps.o: Helen from Kiff gathers her fellow witches, Luz from The Owl House and Dae from Zombies: The Re-Animated Series, for an "enchanted" evening on the town.
When Wyatt and Willa discover that Wynter has fleas, they know she's in desperate need of a bath. Just one problem: Wynter is not gonna make it easy.
When Kiff and Barry lose a flying disc to a super spooky tree, Kiff gets right to the root of the problem by climbing to get it back.
When Kiff tries to throw her best buds a friendsgiving party, her plans are thwarted when a stubborn folding table refuses to stay open.

eps.t: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur: Lunella Puts it Together
eps.o: When a robot that assembles things gets loose in the L.E.S., Moon Girl has to put a stop to her newest invention before it causes total chaos.

eps.t: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur: Devil Goes to the Dentist
eps.o: When Devil gets a toothache, everyone's favorite T-Rex has to head to the dentist for a tooth cleaning of epic proportions.
When everyone in Table Town seems to want some of Kiff's signature hot cocoa, our smart squirrel sets out to make the biggest batch of the sweet stuff ever seen.
When Helen brings Kiff and Barry's snowpeople to life, they'll do anything they can to make sure their new cold cohorts don't get their moment in the sun.
